geofence.tagline: SaaS Healthcare Attendance System with GPS Boundary Verification & Biometrics
geofence.description: An end-to-end hospital staff attendance verification system combining HTML5 Geolocation API, Leaflet map ray-casting, biometric face scanning, and real-time backend verification.

steps.title: GPS Coordinates Acquisition
steps.description: The client browser requests device location permission using the HTML5 Geolocation API to capture precise latitude, longitude, and accuracy radius.
steps.input: User Geolocation Permission & Device GPS Sensors
steps.process: Acquires high-accuracy coordinates (lat, lng, accuracy) via navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition() with timeout safeguards.
steps.output: Raw Geolocation Payload: { lat: 13.0324, lng: 80.1782, accuracy: 5m }

steps.title: Geofence Boundary Validation
steps.description: Evaluates user location against designated hospital polygon boundaries using spatial ray-casting algorithms and Leaflet.js bounds.
steps.input: Raw GPS Payload & Hospital Perimeter Polygon Vertices
steps.process: Calculates point-in-polygon spatial inclusion and verifies distance radius is within the allowed 50-meter threshold.
steps.output: Geofence Status: { insideZone: true, zoneName: 'City General Hospital', distance: '12m' }

steps.title: Biometric Identification & Verification
steps.description: Captures staff biometric data or face landmark embeddings via device camera / WebAuthn API to prevent proxy attendance.
steps.process: Extracts facial landmark vectors or WebAuthn cryptographic signature and computes similarity confidence score (>98%).
steps.technology: WebAuthn API, MediaDevices Stream, HTML5 Canvas
steps.output: Biometric Token: { verified: true, confidence: 99.4%, staffId: 'EMP-4089' }

steps.title: Backend REST API Validation
steps.description: Sends encrypted JSON payload to Express backend for JWT token validation, anti-spoofing checks, and shift schedule verification.
steps.input: HTTPS POST Payload (JWT, Geofence Token, Biometric Hash, Timestamp)
steps.process: Decodes Bearer JWT, validates request timestamp against replay attacks, and checks employee shift roster.
steps.output: Validated Attendance Payload ready for database insertion

steps.title: Database Audit Logging
steps.description: Persists immutable attendance check-in/out records into database with audit trail metadata and spatial location tags.
steps.process: Executes transactional database insert with automatic indexing on staff ID, shift date, and geo-coordinates.

steps.title: Real-Time Dashboard & Notification Sync
steps.description: Broadcasts live attendance updates to hospital department head dashboards and notifies employee via UI toast feedback.
steps.process: Pushes real-time WebSocket event to admin live monitoring panel and returns HTTP 200 JSON status to client UI.
steps.output: Live Dashboard Update & User Check-in Confirmation Screen

expense-tracker.tagline: Full Stack Financial Management & Analytics Application
expense-tracker.description: A comprehensive transaction tracking platform with user authentication, category budget tracking, dynamic chart analytics, and CSV export.

steps.title: User Transaction Entry
steps.description: User submits transaction details (title, amount, expense/income category, date, payment method) via the responsive web form.
steps.input: Form Inputs: Title, Amount ($), Category, Type, Date
steps.process: Performs client-side validation to ensure non-negative values and correct date formatting.

steps.title: State & Budget Calculation
steps.description: Updates in-memory state and recalculates remaining category budgets and overall net balance.
steps.input: Sanitized Transaction Input Object & Current State
steps.process: Computes total income, total expenses, net balance, and flags any exceeded category budget limits.
steps.output: Updated State Object & Budget Warning Flag (if applicable)

steps.title: REST API Transaction Dispatch
steps.description: Transmits transaction payload to backend REST server via AJAX fetch call with authorization headers.
steps.input: JSON Payload: { title, amount, category, type, date }
steps.process: Express router receives POST /api/transactions, verifies session authentication token.

steps.title: Relational Database Storage
steps.description: Executes SQL query to safely insert transaction record into MySQL database table using parameterized queries.
steps.input: SQL Insert Params: (user_id, title, amount, category_id, created_at)
steps.process: Runs INSERT INTO transactions query with transaction isolation to prevent race conditions.

steps.title: Analytics & Chart Visualization
steps.description: Re-renders dynamic financial analytics charts showing category percentage breakdowns and monthly trends.
steps.input: Aggregated Database Totals & Monthly Summary Data
steps.process: Updates canvas-rendered pie charts, bar graphs, and transaction history table with smooth animations.
steps.output: Interactive Analytics Dashboard & Updated History List

developer-portfolio.tagline: Modern Responsive Portfolio with Glassmorphism & Interactive Workflow Visualizer
developer-portfolio.description: A high-performance personal portfolio showcasing full-stack projects, interactive SVG workflow diagrams, dynamic theme toggling, and background particle animation.

steps.title: Static & API Route Request
steps.description: Visitor navigates to portfolio website. Node.js Express server receives HTTP GET request for index.html or API endpoints.
steps.input: HTTP GET / Request from Client Browser
steps.process: Serves index.html with cache headers, Gzip compression, and REST API routing support.

steps.title: Particle Canvas & Theme Initialization
steps.description: Initializes interactive HTML5 background particle canvas and checks saved user theme preference (Dark/Light mode).
steps.input: Local Storage Theme Key & Window Dimensions
steps.process: Sets data-theme attribute on <html> element and spawns canvas particle nodes with mouse collision math.
steps.technology: HTML5 Canvas API, JavaScript ES6, LocalStorage

steps.title: Dynamic Workflow API Request
steps.description: When visitor clicks 'View Workflow' on any project card, JS triggers fetch request to backend workflow REST endpoint.

steps.title: Interactive Diagram & Modal Engine
steps.description: Parses JSON workflow steps, renders SVG connecting flow paths, interactive node cards, and attaches zoom/pan controls.
steps.process: Generates dynamic DOM elements, computes node SVG positions, and sets up click event listeners for step detail inspector.
steps.technology: Vanilla JS DOM Engine, SVG Rendering, CSS Glassmorphism
steps.output: Interactive Workflow Diagram Modal & Step Details Drawer

weather-app.description: Fetches live weather, temperature forecasts, humidity metrics, and atmospheric conditions from OpenWeather API.

steps.title: Location Input / Geolocation
steps.description: User searches for a city name or clicks the current location button.
steps.input: Search Query String (e.g. 'Chennai') or GPS Coordinates
steps.process: Sanitizes search query and encodes URI parameters for weather service request.

steps.title: OpenWeather REST API Call
steps.description: Dispatches asynchronous fetch request to OpenWeather API endpoint with API key and metric units.
steps.process: Fetches current weather JSON payload including temperature, humidity, wind speed, and weather icon code.

steps.title: Data Processing & Dynamic UI Render
steps.description: Normalizes metrics, formats date/time, and updates DOM elements with dynamic weather icons and background gradients.
steps.process: Updates temperature display, humidity gauge, wind speed metrics, and updates weather card background theme.
steps.technology: JavaScript DOM Manipulation, CSS CSS Variables
steps.output: Live Weather Metrics & Animated UI Display
